title: gpt-image-2
prompt:
Use case: poster-cover
Primary request: A premium product-launch poster for 'writing-agent-harness', a personal AI writing orchestration harness. Vertical poster layout, deep charcoal-to-warm-cream gradient background with subtle paper texture and soft golden radial glow behind the central hub.

Top section: Large bold title 'writing-agent-harness' in modern geometric sans-serif, white with warm gold accent underline. Below it a tagline in smaller elegant serif: 'One writing harness. Every AI agent. Your complete editorial workflow.'

Center composition: A luminous central circular hub shaped like a stylized fountain pen nib surrounded by a glowing golden ring, radiating soft curved connecting lines outward like an orbital diagram.

Inner orbit (four stylized fake agent emblems circling the hub, evenly spaced, each a distinct rounded-square badge with a fake geometric logo mark and small label below): 1) a sleek purple/indigo hexagonal badge with a friendly stylized 'C' glyph labeled 'Claude Code'; 2) a teal/turquoise rounded square with an angular chevron 'X' glyph labeled 'Codex'; 3) a warm coral/sunset circular badge with a winged helmet glyph labeled 'Hermes'; 4) a deep midnight blue octagonal badge with an open mechanical claw glyph labeled 'OpenClaw'. Each agent badge has a subtle colored glow and is connected to the central hub by a thin elegant curved golden line.

Outer ring: 8 small circular skill icons evenly spaced around the perimeter, connected by a thin dotted orbit line, each with a tiny simple pictogram and one-word label below in small caps: 'Ideation' (lightbulb), 'Research' (magnifying glass over pages), 'Writing' (fountain pen on paper), 'Polish' (sparkles), 'Illustration' (paintbrush), 'Layout' (grid of cards), 'Publish' (paper plane), 'Retrospective' (circular arrow). The skill icons use a unified warm cream line-art style on dark circular backgrounds.

Bottom strip: A warm gold banner with the text 'Universal agent support for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw — any model, any editor' in small dark text, with a decorative flourish.

Premium tech-product poster aesthetic, editorial design quality, cinematic soft lighting, subtle depth and glow, museum-poster refinement, NOT generic flat SaaS infographic, NOT cold corporate blue. No watermark, no photorealism, no 3D render.
Style/medium: premium product-launch poster, editorial design, elegant tech aesthetic, warm golden accents on deep charcoal
Composition/framing: vertical poster, top title + tagline, central glowing hub, inner orbit of 4 agent badges, outer ring of 8 skill icons, bottom banner
Lighting/mood: soft golden radial glow from center hub, cinematic soft lighting, subtle depth
Color palette: deep charcoal, warm cream paper, gold accents, purple/indigo, teal, coral, midnight blue for agent badges
Materials/textures: premium paper texture, subtle gold foil effect on title and hub
Text (verbatim): "writing-agent-harness, One writing harness. Every AI agent. Your complete editorial workflow., Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, Ideation, Research, Writing, Polish, Illustration, Layout, Publish, Retrospective, Universal agent support"
Constraints: vertical poster format, all English text clearly readable, central hub with pen-nib motif, 4 agent badges in inner orbit, 8 skill icons in outer ring, warm premium aesthetic
Avoid: photorealism, neon cyberpunk, flat corporate SaaS blue, 3D render, watermark, cluttered layout, unreadable tiny text
